title: Sunday Pancakes
subtitle: 考点：食谱步骤 / mix, pour, heat / 顺序词
passage: Every Sunday morning, Lucy makes pancakes for her family. The recipe is simple, and you only need a few ingredients: flour, eggs, milk, a little sugar and some butter.

First, mix the flour, sugar and eggs in a big bowl. Then pour the milk into the bowl and stir until the mixture is smooth. Next, heat a pan and put a small piece of butter in it. When the butter is hot, pour some of the mixture into the pan. Wait for about two minutes, then turn the pancake over. Cook the other side for one more minute.

Lucy puts the pancakes on a plate and adds a little honey or fruit. Her brother likes them with cream, but her father prefers them plain. “The secret is to use a hot pan,” says Lucy. Everyone enjoys the warm pancakes, and there is always a mess in the kitchen afterwards!
